sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a clothing line informed by hip-hop music and the work of fashion designer Dapper Dan is among projects from the Lebanese American University. Also featured are handover pieces designed to reflect Pakistani culture and clothing that takes inspiration from sculptor John Chamberlain's creations. Lebanese American University Institution: School of Architecture and Design The post Streetwear informed by hip-hop among projects from the Lebanese American University appeared first on Dezeen .
